title: Diary, Half-Lit
description: A slow-burn diary ballad that opens beatless on felt piano and a breathy, pitched vocal chop, lush sidechained pad swelling underneath. A restrained CasioRZ1 shuffle and warm sub bass enter late, the chords darkening from minor to a wistful resolve before stripping back to piano and breath.
